key.name: mode
key.description: palette: fade through the colours; rainbow: rotate the hue; pulse: first colour, glow breathes; static: first colour, no timer at all.

key.name: cycle-seconds
key.description: How long one full colour cycle (or one breath in pulse mode) takes.

key.name: fps
key.description: Only the colour changes per tick; the border geometry follows window signals.

key.name: border-width
key.description: Width of the neon line, drawn just outside the window frame.

key.name: border-radius
key.description: Match this to your windows' rounded corners (libadwaita windows are about 12-15 px).

key.name: glow-size
key.description: Blur radius of the soft glow around the border. 0 turns the glow off.

key.name: show-on-maximized
key.description: Fullscreen windows never get a border.

key.name: colors
key.description: List of #RRGGBB colours for the palette mode (the first one is used by static and pulse). Empty uses the Night City palette.
